sent_bad: Based on `doc.txt`, here are four customer-awareness strategies you can implement quickly, tailored to your store (single entry/exit, ~3 CCTV cameras, two registers, high traffic):
Since you have one entry and exit, place signs at the entrance/exit and near your two registers.
This is fast to do before you open.
With your three cameras, position/point them at your single entry/exit and make their presence visible to customers — the deterrent effect depends on customers knowing they're being watched.
You can draft a short policy and post it at your entrance today.
For your two registers, you can add eye-level "You're being monitored" messaging and aim a camera at each register so customers see their face and know items are being watched as they're scanned.

All four are low-cost and can be in place before you open: signs and posted policy (strategies 1 and 3), visible camera placement at the entry/exit (strategy 2), and register-level monitoring messaging (strategy 4).
